caption:
Six chapters. And they called it thunder. (Galatians — a new verse-by-verse series starts today)

We're beginning a new walk through Galatians — Paul's most thunderous letter, and the charter of Christian freedom. Before the first verse, here's the overview: who wrote it, who it was for, and the one cry of grace beneath every line. The whole letter says one thing — you were never saved by what you add; you're free because of what He already did.
